name: Wifely Duties
overview: Scripture outlines wifely duties as grounded in wisdom, submission, love, and reverence within the marriage relationship. Proverbs highlights the wise woman who builds her household, while Ephesians and Colossians emphasize the call for wives to submit to their husbands as to the Lord. Titus encourages women to teach younger women to love their husbands and children with sobriety and wisdom, reflecting a Christ-centered model of family life.
